agentSummary:
The repo calls four external services:

- **Replicate** (raw HTTP): `app/generate/route.ts` sends `POST https://api.replicate.com/v1/predictions` at line 40. It then polls the returned `urls.get` every second at line 72. The model version hash is pinned at line 47, and the key comes from `REPLICATE_API_KEY`.
- **Upstash** (SDK): `@upstash/ratelimit`, backed by `@upstash/redis` through the REST API. The `ratelimit.limit` call at `app/generate/route.ts:21` allows 5 requests per 24 hours per IP. The Redis client is built in `utils/redis.ts` and is skipped if the `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_*` env vars are unset. I recorded only the ratelimit call site, because `utils/redis.ts` only builds the client.
- **Bytescale** (SDK): the `UploadDropzone` widget at `app/dream/page.tsx:56` uploads the image. `UrlBuilder.url` at line 62 builds the thumbnail URL that is sent on to Replicate. The key is `NEXT_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_API_KEY`, falling back to `"free"`. The code imports `@bytescale/sdk` and `@bytescale/upload-widget`, but neither is listed in `package.json`, so I recorded the version of `@bytescale/upload-widget-react` (`^4.9.0`).
- **Vercel Analytics** (SDK): the `<Analytics />` component at `app/layout.tsx:42`.

Two fetches are not recorded as providers:

- `fetch("/generate")` in `app/dream/page.tsx` is the app's own backend.
- `utils/downloadPhoto.ts` fetches the generated image URL that Replicate returned. I did not record it as a separate call site, though it arguably belongs to Replicate's file host.

The other hosts the scan found (GitHub, Twitter, Vercel, replicate.com, bytescale.com) are only links in the page markup.

I recorded each provider's SDK version as the `package.json` range, not the resolved lockfile version. I did not look up locked versions.
